general: The guide has only recall and trading tips, no matchups. Recall timings: if the lane is rough, back at 400 gold for Tear; if you started Tear, back at 500 for Long Sword plus a refillable potion. If the lane is going well, stay until about 1100 gold for Sheen plus Tear (or 1050 for Sheen plus Long Sword with a Tear start), since Sheen is the key early spike. Poke with Q until your passive is fully stacked, then weave autos with the bonus attack speed only when it is safe, preferring auto trades into short-range lanes without crowd control. Never use E aggressively unless you are certain you'll survive; if you can't get autos off, take First Strike and play around Q poke in fights.
